def find_in_ascii(frame_ascii, char):
    lines = frame_ascii.split('\n')
    positions = []
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        for j, c in enumerate(line):
            if c == char:
                positions.append((i, j))
    return positions

y_curr = sorted(find_in_ascii(current_frame.ascii, 'Y'))
gameplay_y = [p for p in y_curr if 5 < p[0] < 60]
print(f"Player position: {gameplay_y}")

# Check layout around player
curr_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("Layout (rows 7-15, cols 0-20):")
for i in range(7, 16):
    row = curr_lines[i]
    simplified = ''.join(['.' if c == 'c' else c for c in row[:21]])
    print(f"Row {i}: '{simplified}'")

# Check if we can move down (gray bar at rows 10-11, cols 8-62)
# Player needs to be at col < 8 to go down
print("\nGray bar extent:")
for i in range(10, 12):
    row = curr_lines[i]
    g_positions = [j for j, c in enumerate(row) if c == 'G']
    if g_positions:
        print(f"Row {i}: cols {min(g_positions)}-{max(g_positions)}")
